title: Launch tests run the distill in mode auto, so on a host with the plugin installed they could push test entries
goal: Every test that runs the real distill (TestLaunch, test_shell_form_*, the e2e launches) runs it where delivery cannot reach a real remote: querylog_env (or the tests) pins the query log to mode local, or points delivery at a local bare remote, so a maintainer host with the it-ops-kb plugin installed from GitLab never clones the install source or pushes test entries; a test plants a recorded install source and asserts nothing is cloned or pushed.

run: import pathlib,re,sys; t=pathlib.Path('_tools/conftest.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); m=re.search(r'def querylog_env.*?(?=\ndef )', t, re.S); sys.exit(0 if m and re.search(r'mode|deliver|local', m.group(0)) else 1)
